subject: Proposal: expansion ladder + midterm proration play
messages:
From: Maria Gomez <maria.gomez@novaflow.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@novaflow.com
Date: Tue, 6 Oct 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal discussion — potential top-up and billing cadence

Kimberly —

Thanks for the call this morning. Quick recap from our side and a couple of asks so we can move procurement:

- We're seeing a 40% QoQ uptick in inference volume for the latest model. That starts mid-November.
- We need a predictable midterm path (Nov -> Feb) without triggering a full-year re-commit.
- Procurement can sign a short amendment if we provide a clear proration and invoice map; they need a PO by 10/20.

Can you send a one-page playbook (pricing ladder + proration examples) showing: a) incremental commit sizes, b) discount % by effective run-rate, and c) what co-term vs standalone top-up means for invoicing? Also, include expected lead time if we want dedicated capacity for the burst.

If possible, include a simple example invoice showing prorated charges in the first and second months. That helps speed internal approvals.

Best,
Maria
Senior Product Ops
Novaflow
(Attachment: monthly-usage-export.csv)
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Maria Gomez <maria.gomez@novaflow.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 6 Oct 2026 11:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal discussion — potential top-up and billing cadence

Maria —

Thanks for the clear ask. I've looped in Ben (AM) and Priyom (pricing) to draft the one-pager + worked example. High-level proposal below; we'll attach the spreadsheet and a draft SOW for PO.

Proposal (summary):
- "Expand Sync Ladder" — 3-step midterm ladder for a 3-month ramp (Nov, Dec, Jan) with co-term to existing renewal in March.
  - Step A: +20% commit (Nov start), 0% one-time discount.
  - Step B: +40% commit (Dec start), 7% volume discount on incremental units.
  - Step C: +60% commit (Jan start), 12% volume discount on incremental units + 60-day grace window for final usage true-up.
- Proration: charge full for the month of activation for increased commit, then apply pro rata credit toward next invoice if usage is lower. We show two invoice examples in the spreadsheet.
- Co-term option: we recommend co-terming to reduce administrative overhead; standalone top-up allowed if preferred (but incremental pricing slightly higher).
- Dedicated capacity: 3-week lead time for capacity reservation on our Dedicated pool; we can accelerate to 10 business days with a 10% capacity reservation fee.

Deliverables: spreadsheet with line-item invoices + the draft amendment (SOW) for procurement.

We'll send the attachments in a follow-up within the hour. Let us know if Procurement needs a DocuSign link or a sealed PO format.

—Kimberly
Director, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
(Attachment: expanded-pricing-ladder-v1.xlsx)
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Maria Gomez <maria.gomez@novaflow.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 6 Oct 2026 13:17:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal discussion — potential top-up and billing cadence

Maria — thanks for the prompt. Two quick clarifications from a commercial perspective:

1) Price ladder mechanics: the % discounts apply only to incremental spend above your current committed baseline (not retroactive). Example in sheet shows baseline = 1M tokens/month.
2) Migration to co-term: if Novaflow elects to co-term, we apply a one-time credit to align invoices — this appears as a negative line on the March invoice in the worked example.

If Procurement wants a fixed monthly blended rate instead of a ladder, we can provide a blended quote for the three-month period (we included that variant in the spreadsheet, tab: "blended-quote").

I'll be available Friday morning for a quick procurement walk-through.

—Ben
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
From: Maria Gomez <maria.gomez@novaflow.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 7 Oct 2026 08:09:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal discussion — potential top-up and billing cadence

Thanks — the ladder looks reasonable. A couple of follow-ups from Procurement: they want the PO to reference a specific SOW line, and they asked whether the 60-day grace window can be extended to 90 days for the Jan->Mar true-up. Also — legal asked if the dedicated capacity reservation fee can be invoiced separately as a non-recurring charge so it doesn't affect ARR.

Can you add the 90-day option as an alternate in the SOW and mark the capacity fee as NRC (non-recurring charge) in the invoice example? If you can get that by EOD Friday, Procurement can generate the PO on 10/20.

Appreciate the fast turn.

Maria
From: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
To: Maria Gomez <maria.gomez@novaflow.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 12 Oct 2026 16:24:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Proposal: expansion ladder + midterm proration play

Maria —

Appended the requested alternates:

- SOW: added an option block for a 90-day true-up (label: Option B — 90d grace).
- Invoices: capacity reservation fee is now shown as a separate non-recurring charge (line-item NRC) and excluded from the blended ARR calculation.
- PO reference: added explicit SOW line numbers and a sample PO text block you can paste into Procurement's system.

Files attached to this note: draft-sow-midterm-amend.pdf, expanded-pricing-ladder-v1.xlsx, novaflow-monthly-usage-snapshot.csv.

Next steps: if that all looks good, Kimberly will send a DocuSign-ready amendment; Procurement can send the PO to billing@redwood.com with the sample text and we will lock the 10/20 PO deadline.

Thanks — Priyom
Pricing & Packaging, Redwood Inference
(Attachment: draft-sow-midterm-amend.pdf)
